messages:
natalie-acme: Hey team — our May invoice INV-9832 shows as unpaid and the portal says 'Upfront required'. We requested Net 60 on signup. Also got an email that the card declined. PO 78910 attached. Can someone check?

olivia-support: Sorry to hear that — looking now. Can you confirm the invoice and the card used? and drop the PO PDF if you have it. :eyes:

natalie-acme: Invoice INV-9832, card ends 4242. PO PDF uploaded to the portal (po_78910.pdf). We also included VAT ID: GB999888777.

billing-bot: Payment system log snippet for invoice INV-9832:
```
payment_attempt: {
  invoice_id: "INV-9832",
  status: "declined",
  gateway_code: "insufficient_funds",
  attempt_ts: "2026-03-10T14:22:10Z",
  payment_method_last4: "4242"
}
```

maya-finance: Quick note — system shows a tax recalculation mismatch for this invoice. The billing address VAT ID doesn't match the EU VAT registry lookup so tax line got added, which bumped the amount. That can trigger downstream approval flags (our system currently flips "require_upfront" for tax-discrepancy invoices).

liam-payments: Repro & potential cause: when customer metadata has `po_number` the UI toggles `upfront=false`, but there's an edge bug where if VAT_validation: "pending" then `require_upfront` is set to true. Repro steps:
1) create invoice with `metadata: {po_number: "", vat_id: "GB..."}`
2) call `POST /v1/invoices` with `allow_net_terms=true`
3) simulate VAT lookup returning "pending"
Observed: invoice.require_upfront === true (should be false).

olivia-support: Can we do a manual override while this is sorted? Customer needs Net 60 honored if they provide PO + VAT cert.

maya-finance: Yes — we can provisionally mark the invoice as Net 60 and issue a provisional credit if payment already attempted. Conditions: must receive signed PO (po_78910) + VAT registration docs within 5 business days. If not received, we re-bill and reattempt collection.

liam-payments: For engineering — quick patch suggestion: change logic from `if (vat_status !== "valid") require_upfront = true` to `if (vat_status === "invalid" && !has_po) require_upfront = true`. I'll open a PR and add unit tests.

olivia-support: Action items:
- @liam-payments open PR + test (ETA EOD) :thumbsup:
- @maya-finance create provisional credit & set invoice due_date = now + 60 days (pending docs)
- I will send customer the card-update link and request VAT cert + signed PO.

billing-bot: AR ticket created: AR-2026-1145 assigned to maya-finance.

natalie-acme: Thanks — we'll upload the VAT cert and signed PO today. Appreciate the provisional hold.

maya-finance: Done: provisional credit issued (CR-4620) and invoice marked Net 60 pending docs. I've added a note to the AR ticket with the deadline (2026-03-24).

liam-payments: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/patches/3245 — includes fix + regression test for the VAT/p o path. Leaving a comment for runtime to watch for similar flags in older invoices.

olivia-support: Closing loop for now. Reopen if customer can't upload the docs or if payment retries fail. :white_check_mark:

natalie-acme: Uploaded VAT cert and signed PO just now. Let me know if you need anything else. Thanks!
